Script.name: Adjustable Container Foundation
Script.script:
-- GUI.AdjustableContainers - early foundation -- -- This fragment must load before the 01_gui.xml composite wrapper. Its -- GUI Boot child creates core boxes immediately while Mudlet imports the -- package, so delaying this namespace until the later layout-profile child -- leaves those boxes without parents and creates labels on the root window.
GUI = GUI or {} GUI.AdjustableContainers = GUI.AdjustableContainers or {}
-- Preserve the registry across an in-place package upgrade so stale objects -- can be removed before replacements are created. GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers = GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers or {}
GUI.AdjustableContainers.currentProfile = GUI.AdjustableContainers.currentProfile or "default"
GUI.AdjustableContainers.saveDir = string.format("%s/LuminariGUI/layouts/", getMudletHomeDir())
GUI.AdjustableContainers.defaultStyle = { adjLabelstyle = [[ background-image: url(]] .. getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. [[/LuminariGUI/images/ui_texture.jpg); background-color: rgba(38, 25, 47, 0.9); border: 2px solid rgba(184, 115, 27, 0.8); border-radius: 5px; padding: 5px; font-family: Tahoma, Geneva, sans-serif; ]], buttonstyle = [[ QLabel { border-radius: 7px; background-color: rgba(100,100,100,100%); border: 1px solid rgba(184, 115, 27, 0.5); } QLabel::hover { background-color: rgba(120,120,120,100%); border: 1px solid rgba(184, 115, 27, 0.8); } QLabel::pressed { background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(184, 115, 27, 1.0); } ]], titleTxtColor = "#FFD700", buttonFontSize = 10, buttonsize = 20, padding = 5, autoSave = true, autoLoad = true, noClose = true, defaultDir = GUI.AdjustableContainers.saveDir }
function GUI.AdjustableContainers.generateName(baseName) return "LuminariGUI_" .. baseName end
function GUI.AdjustableContainers.register(container, name, componentType) if not container then print("ERROR: Cannot register nil container: " .. (name or "unknown")) return false end
GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[name] = { container = container, name = name, componentType = componentType, created = os.time(), profile = GUI.AdjustableContainers.currentProfile }
print("✓ Registered container: " .. name .. " (" .. componentType .. ")") return true end
local function disposeExistingContainer(fullName) local registered = GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[fullName] local existing = registered and registered.container
if not existing and Adjustable and Adjustable.Container and Adjustable.Container.all then existing = Adjustable.Container.all[fullName] end
if not existing then return end
GUI.debug("GUI/CONTAINER", "replacing existing adjustable container", { name = fullName, existing = type(existing), })
if type(existing.disableAutoSave) == "function" then pcall(existing.disableAutoSave, existing) end if type(existing.detach) == "function" then pcall(existing.detach, existing) end if type(existing.delete) == "function" then local deleted = pcall(existing.delete, existing) if not deleted and type(existing.hide) == "function" then pcall(existing.hide, existing) end elseif type(existing.hide) == "function" then pcall(existing.hide, existing) end
GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[fullName] = nil if Adjustable and Adjustable.Container and Adjustable.Container.all then Adjustable.Container.all[fullName] = nil end end
function GUI.AdjustableContainers.create(name, componentType, config) local fullName = GUI.AdjustableContainers.generateName(name)
-- In-place package upgrades retain Lua/Geyser objects. Remove the prior -- object before reusing its globally unique Mudlet window names. disposeExistingContainer(fullName)
local containerConfig = {} for key, value in pairs(GUI.AdjustableContainers.defaultStyle) do containerConfig[key] = value end if config then for key, value in pairs(config) do containerConfig[key] = value end end containerConfig.name = fullName
local container = Adjustable.Container:new(containerConfig) if not container then print("ERROR: Failed to create container: " .. fullName) return nil end
GUI.AdjustableContainers.register(container, fullName, componentType) return container end
function GUI.AdjustableContainers.show(name) local containerInfo = GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[name] if containerInfo and containerInfo.container then containerInfo.container:show() return true end return false end
function GUI.AdjustableContainers.hide(name) local containerInfo = GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[name] if containerInfo and containerInfo.container then containerInfo.container:hide() return true end return false end
function GUI.AdjustableContainers.destroy(name) local containerInfo = GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[name] if containerInfo and containerInfo.container then if type(containerInfo.container.delete) == "function" then pcall(containerInfo.container.delete, containerInfo.container) else containerInfo.container:hide() end GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers[name] = nil print("✓ Destroyed container: " .. name) return true end return false end
GUI.debug("BOOT/FOUNDATION", "AdjustableContainers foundation loaded", { create = type(GUI.AdjustableContainers.create), saveDir = GUI.AdjustableContainers.saveDir, })
